value.summary: Extended render() in lib/render.mjs to accept an optional second argument: render(user, options = {}) returns `Dear ${user.name}` when options.formal === true and `Hi ${user.name}` otherwise, so the one-argument call is unchanged. Extended tests/render.test.mjs: the original informal test is untouched; added tests for formal: true, omitted options, empty options, and formal: false. Ran the suite with node --test; all tests pass. Satisfied: formal mode added, existing one-argument behavior and existing tests preserved unchanged.
